_comment: This directory is NOT a workspace, so it inherits nothing from the repo's tsconfig.
Without this file the build ran on TypeScript defaults and reported six errors it then
deployed anyway — node:http, node:url and four uses of `process` all unresolvable, because
@types/node was absent. Vercel's typechecking is advisory: it reports and ships.
moduleResolution nodenext is what makes a `./x.js` specifier resolve to x.ts.
